$comment: Default field values for the 'authenticated' security profile. MarinOS has no authenticated application in production yet — defined ahead of need, per standard.md. Note: an authenticated app likely implies a real backend, which every other current MarinOS app doesn't have (they're all static GitHub Pages). The header-achievability defaults below assume the same static-hosting constraint as the other profiles; if the first authenticated app actually has a server, revisit headers/csp for that app specifically rather than trusting this file's defaults blindly.
